rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; i8582 p. 13, Part VIII—Allowed Losses: use Part VIII only for an activity listed in Part VII; column (a) is the net loss plus the prior-year unallowed loss, column (b) is column (c) of Part VII. This activity has a \$4,000 current gain and a \$2,000 prior-year unallowed loss already deducted on line 22, so it has no Part VII entry and its Part VIII loss allowed is \$0; the project computes \$2,000 by subtracting p7c from net loss plus prior loss without that gate. BUG-0934. Severity medium.
